enfoque_corto: Koryo, Taebaek and Pyonwong + advanced ChanonaFlex
enfoque: This cycle will focus on specific lines from Koryo, Taebaek and Pyonwong. We will also keep advanced ChanonaFlex, glute isometric work, Yop Chagui and Ap Chagui level 2, plus technical kicking with Ap Chagui, Yop Chagui and band work. The priority will be clean technique, posture, control, timing and precise execution.

Control extension, return and posture in Yop Chagui.

apuntes: Work with technical precision, giving priority to correct execution before a high kick.
Keep short pauses when needed to preserve good posture and better technical quality.
The priority is to train with intelligence, order and control in every repetition.
In Koryo, Taebaek and Pyonwong, take care of cuts, preparation, direction, posture and timing before looking for speed.
